name: Menu
summary: A popup list of actions or choices opened by a button.

pattern.html: <button aria-haspopup> with role=menu, or a popover listbox

anatomy.description: An action or a choice; a chosen one has a check.

keyboard.action: Open; actions focus the first item, choices focus the selected option when available.
Close and return to the button.
Close and continue through the page.
Type-ahead to a matching item; repeated letters cycle.

a11y.name: The button's label.
notes: A menu of links is a disclosure with links, not role=menu.
Disabled items stay discoverable with aria-disabled but cannot be activated.
The runnable reference demonstrates focus, type-ahead, selection, dismissal and viewport placement; the product owns actions and persistence.

Placement: CSS anchor positioning holds the menu below its trigger at the start edge and flips it when space runs out (anchor-name on the trigger, position-anchor on the menu); a script places it where the engine lacks anchor positioning.
